ideas.pitch: An autonomous agent governance gateway built using Lyzr that intercepts multi-step agent actions, executes pre-deployment risk checks via structured BPMN workflows, and enforces quantitative token and latency budgets.
ideas.title: Lyzr-Agent-Guard: Automated BPMN Risk & Governance Gateway
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the hackathon's core emphasis on agentic governance and quantitative evaluation rubrics rather than basic prompt loops.

ideas.pitch: A training-free semantic router and LLM-judge feedback loop built on Lyzr that dynamically routes tasks between specialized agents while continuously scoring retrieval precision and updating an exemplar index.
ideas.title: Evaluator-in-the-Loop: Self-Correcting Semantic Router for Multi-Agent Systems
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors winning architectures that focus on rigorous quantitative metrics like retrieval precision and self-improvement loops.

ideas.pitch: A dual-agent benchmarking harness where one agent attempts to trigger harmful or hallucinated outputs while a defensive Lyzr governance agent dynamically monitors token bounds, runtime speed, and grounding metrics.
ideas.title: Adversarial Stress-Test Suite for Autonomous Agent Governance
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the hackathon judging criteria of stress-testing agents against strict quantitative production metrics instead of relying on pitch decks.

ideas.pitch: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server integration using Lyzr that instruments multi-agent tool calls with hard limits on token budgets, runtime speed, and execution precision.
ideas.title: TokenBudget-MCP: Federated Tool Registry with Real-Time Latency & Cost Controls
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly satisfies the hackathon's explicit focus on passing rigorous benchmarks across token budgets and runtime speed.

ideas.pitch: A RAG augmentation layer specifically tailored for Lyzr agents that automatically instruments document retrieval with grounding scores, filtering out unverified context before agent consumption.
ideas.title: Auto-Grounding & Precision RAG Toolkit for Production Agents
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on retrieval precision and grounding metrics, which are core quantitative evaluation rubrics stressed in the event description.
